dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder (functional dystonia/dyskinesia)

Alternative diagnoses to still consider:
1. Paroxysmal non-kinesigenic dyskinesia (PNKD) - genetic or idiopathic
2. Dystonia due to other cause not yet identified (genetic testing warranted)
3. Autoimmune/encephalitic process not detected by current antibody panels (wider antibody testing or repeat lumbar puncture may be considered)
